errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the color of the "Press Release (4/38)" slice as gold. In the chart, this slice is clearly yellow.

errors.text_span: Moving clockwise from the top, the segments include a small orange slice labeled "Intra-agency news article (1/38)", a dark red slice labeled "Draft/Other (9/38)", a dark brown slice labeled "Email (5/38)", a muted purple slice labeled "Organizational Report (2/38)", a dark navy blue slice labeled "Interview (2/38)", the largest slice in dark green labeled "External News Article (15/38)", and a gold slice labeled "Press Release (4/38)"
errors.evidence: The description states that the listed sequence of slices is in clockwise order, which is factually incorrect. For example, moving clockwise from the "Intra-agency news article" slice (orange) leads to the "Press Release" slice (yellow), not the "Draft/Other" slice (red) as claimed in the list.
